title: Abhishek Banerjee alleges 'BJP hooligans' attacked his Kolkata residence
description:
TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee on Saturday alleged that his residence here was attacked by "BJP hooligans" early on Saturday, triggering clashes between supporters of the two parties.
Banerjee, a three-term Diamond Harbour MP, claimed that the attack was part of a conspiracy to kill him, alleging that his office and residence had been under surveillance for two consecutive days before the incident.
He said several of his supporters were seriously injured in the clashes.
"After two days of continuous recce, this is how BJP hooligans attacked my house at 2 am today. Watch the footage and see for yourself. If this is what can happen to an elected Member of Parliament, imagine the plight of the common man in WB," Banerjee said in a post on X, sharing a video purportedly showing the incident.
PTI could not independently verify the authenticity of the video.
The incident reportedly began around 2 am when BJP supporters allegedly raised 'chor' (thief) slogans outside Banerjee's Kalighat reside
